QUOTE: Unless `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is defined, it expands to `private_##member`, so the public struct field is really named `private_member`. ... Inside the library, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` is just `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the macro expands differently depending on whether the opt-in is defined (library and opted-in programs get plain names, other consumers get `private_` names).
